items.title: #217 bento research brief v1: Dave three-role taxonomy tested against practice (Apple tile CSS measured 18px radius, Flickr justified-layout widows + fullWidthBreakoutRowCadence, concentricity WWDC25, dense-flow a11y trap)
items.closes_when: Dave has read the verdict and ruled on the three bends: GALLERY role vs justified-row family, the flush/container-radius dashboard signature having no bento precedent (only Apple concentricity + inset-grouped lists), and whether orphan/squaring policy is a role property or an orthogonal parameter
items.body: Opus research sub, web sweep. Verdict: BROCHUREWARE confirmed hard (Apple .tile-rounded{border-radius:18px}, white ground, per-tile shadow, one uniform 16-24px gutter is universal practice). DASHBOARD role confirmed but the near-zero internal spacing has NO published bento precedent - mainstream dashboard guidance warns below ~12px gutters cards merge; the real precedent is Apple concentricity (inner radius = parent radius - padding, WWDC25 verbatim) plus inset-grouped lists, and the standards-track CSS gap decorations (row-rule/column-rule, css-gaps-1). GALLERY bends: real photo walls run Flickr justified-layout, not spans - rows justify flush to both edges, only the last row is ragged, and orphans are a named first-class concept (widowCount, showWidows). Every-Nth rhythm and aspect-driven spans have strong precedent: fullWidthBreakoutRowCadence with an aspect-ratio>=1 guard. Biggest live risk: grid-auto-flow dense reorders visually while focus follows DOM (WCAG 2.4.3/1.3.2) - the built mint-time squaring pass AVOIDS this and that is an advantage over industry practice. Missing: no algorithmic bento generator published anywhere; no prefers-reduced-motion guidance in any bento source; nesting essentially undiscussed. 13 primary sources fetched, secondary ones marked UNVERIFIED in the doc.
